data.title: 角楯花凛 · 赌船专属休息室的深蓝兔女郎
data.description: 门锁紧扣的豪华游轮贵宾卧室内，花凛换上了执行特勤任务的高开衩深蓝兔女郎连体衣。黑丝长腿交叠坐在红色丝绒长榻上，修长有力的身材曲线展露无遗。长长的黑兔耳随着她偏头的动作轻晃，小麦色的脸颊微微浮现红晕，平时端庄冷酷的狙击手把手搭在腿上，眼神羞涩却坚定地接受着老师赞许的目光。
data.location: exclusive cruise ship VIP velvet lounge under chandelier
data.action: sitting with long black-stockinged legs crossed on crimson velvet settee, highleg navy bunny suit, rabbit ears, dark skin, slight blush on cheeks, golden eyes meeting viewer
data.lighting: dramatic golden chandelier glow casting rich highlights on satin and stockings
data.mood: striking sensual glamour, shy warrior compliance
data.promptProse: Sitting with crossed legs on a crimson velvet settee, Kakudate Karin wears a high-cut navy bunny suit and black tights. Her dark skin contrasts beautifully with the blue satin as she gazes forward with a shy yet poised golden look.
data.animaCaption: Karin in a navy bunny suit and black stockings on a velvet settee, gazing with golden eyes.
